text:
5 years ago, when we started the hot box we were just 3 lads with a trailer by the river boyne and i think most of you now know the story of how that story goes

but there was something else that started to happen too

people came to the hot box alone

and we started getting messages from customers telling us how much the sauna had helped their mental health

the act of coming to a social space, being somewhat vulnerable I guess as you’re half naked

and getting chatting to people seemed to do wonders for peoples minds

And we still get messages like this every day 

So, given its world mental health day today, we wanted to do something to mark it

Next week from Monday to Friday, you can bring a friend to any hot box as with you for free on us for any off peak session

So pick up the phone, call that friend, check in on them and invite them to the sauna

It’s a great place to sweat it all out and feel better!

to bring your friend for free, create an account and purchase the mental health day bundle and it will give you two passes for the price of one for any off peak session valid until next Friday

text:
One of the last days of summer before the colder and darker weather came. One of our favourite things about the area here, it that you can go from breathtaking hikes to swims in the fjord, sauna, cinnamon buns and good food within an hour. We started our day with a prest to Hike, continued down to the sauna for some heath and fjord swim, then headed over to Mariannes bakeri for an amazing lunch, coffee and cinnamon buns. 

Ein av dei siste finværsdagane i september før høsten virkelig kom til Vestlandet. Noko av det beste me veit med å vere her, er at ein kan vere på ein fantastisk tur - og innan ein time vere nede igjen til fjorden, ta sauna, ta eit friskt bad og ete god mat. 

Me starta dagen med ein tur til Prest med fantastisk utsikt. Deretter varma me oss skikkelig opp i sauna før me kjølte oss ned i fjorden. Og selvfølgelig reiste me innom Mariannes bakeri for lunsj og deilig bakst etterpå.

text:
Viktig melding til alle som har spurt om det blir sesongkort! 🧖🏼🧖🏽‍♀️

Sjølvsagt skal de få nyte det beste av saunasesongen i år også. Me jobbar iherdig med siste finpuss no, så publiserer me på sosiale medier så snart alt er klart på nettsida.

Men i år gjer me ein liten endring: Sesongkortet blir bytta ut med medlemskap! 

Det betyr altså:

• Du betalar berre når du brukar saunaen.
• Du får medlemspris kvar gong du brukar sauna, heile året. 
• Rabatterte prisar på alt av fellessauna, privatsauna, ritualer og produkt i butikken vår.

Me gler oss til ein ny saunasesong – og til å ha dykk med vidare!

Important message to everyone who has been asking if there will be a season pass this year! 🔥🧖‍♀️

Of course, you’ll still get to enjoy the best of sauna season this year too! We’re working hard on the final details now, and we’ll share everything on social media as soon as everything is ready on the website.

But this year, we’re making a small change: We’re replacing the season pass with a membership!

This means:

• You only pay when you use the sauna.
• You get the discounted member price every time, all year. 
• Discounted prices on all shared sauna sessions, private sauna, rituals and products in our shop.
